traffic.message: Engine 5, Ladder 2, Battalion 1, structure fire, 400 Mill Street, caller reports smoke from the roof.
Engine 5 on scene, two-story warehouse, heavy smoke showing. Engine 5 has command.
Mayday, mayday, mayday. Ladder 2, firefighter down, second floor, east side.
All units, emergency traffic. Mayday on Tactical 1. Hold the channel.
Battalion 1 is assuming command from Engine 5. Request a personnel accountability report.

fields.notes: Tactical 1 carried both the mayday and routine hose requests for two minutes.
